CustomField.description: This field shall be used by "City" Recordtype only. Displays the location as "City, Country" by default. If the Country is "United States", it shows "City, State, United States".
CustomField.formula: IF( $RecordType.Name = "City", IF( Parent__c != null && Parent__r.Parent__c != null && Parent__r.Parent__r.Geo_Code__c != 'US', Geo_Name__c + ', ' + Parent__r.Parent__r.Geo_Name__c, Name ), IF( $RecordType.Name = "State", IF( Parent__r.BP_Uses_States__c = TRUE, Name, '' ), Name ) )
CustomField.label: Short Name
